POC focused on Private VPC with strict EU-only residency. Customer: security-first platform provider operating EU legal entity. Key ask: turnkey VPC deployment where all inference compute and logs remain in EU regions (primary: eu-west-1, fallback: eu-central-1).

- Security review: underway. Received initial security questionnaire (SIG-lite) 2026-02-18; legal flagged data retention and export-control language.
- KMS: must integrate with customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) and HSM-backed KMS preferred. Need diagram showing key rotation and access patterns.
- Audit logging: granular audit logs per token/request, retention options (90/365/730 days). Must show how logs are stored in customer VPC and accessible via SIEM.
- Model hosting: prefer open models (Llama2-70B in quantized variant) but legal concerned about weights residency; exploring Redwood suggestion to use verified hosted model variant pinned within customer account.
- Routing/fallback: require pass-through routing to EU-only fallback pools; no cross-border failover to NA during normal operation.
- Latency/throughput targets: p95 latency <120ms for reranking ops, <300ms for chat generation at 20 RPS steady; batch embeddings throughput target 150 QPS.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high. Interested in Optimize recommendations for batching and quantization.
